files.name: CHANGELOG.md
files.body:
Upgrade note: this release adds a per-folder table for media counts. The first
count after the update walks each gallery once; later changes recount only the
folders that changed.

- choose pages or continuous scrolling for each gallery's public links
- request the next file block earlier and show decoded tiles immediately in
  continuous galleries
- browse across gallery batches in the guest lightbox while keeping the photo
  counter tied to the current folder and filters
- use swipe and full-width thumbnails in the mobile lightbox, and hide the
  toolbar and filmstrip together when zooming with auto-hide enabled
- keep the lightbox controls hidden while swiping and reveal them with a tap
- allow left-button dragging to pan a zoomed photo without closing the viewer
- return to the gallery with one tap, including after swiping or opening a
  direct photo link
- keep Previous and Next photo reachable by keyboard and screen reader when
  the mobile lightbox hides its controls, and show the controls when one of
  them receives focus
- count photos and videos in the owner gallery list much faster, and after a
  change recount only the folders that changed
- load public folder and collection pages with far fewer database queries,
  and keep large folders cached when the server uses Memcached
- archive and purge galleries whose shared folder or file was deleted
- record one share-audit view per visit in continuous galleries instead of
  one per loaded batch
